captions.detailed: A compound angle vise featuring a rectangular dark grey base plate. Above the base is a dark blue cylindrical swivel platform, which supports a tilting bracket that pivots on a horizontal axis. Mounted on top is a dark blue vise bed with a fixed rear jaw block and a movable front jaw block on light grey dovetail guide rails, driven by a central metallic leadscrew and handwheel.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an articulated compound angle vise in CadQuery. The design should feature a bottom swivel base, an intermediate tilt stage, and a top vise assembly with a movable front jaw driven by a central leadscrew and handwheel.
captions.factory: Construct the base plate as a thin rectangular Box. Model the swivel base using a flat Cylinder, connected to a tilting cradle using a revolute joint. Build the main vise bed with prismatic dovetail guide rails, a fixed jaw block, and a translation-constrained moving jaw block. Add a central threaded rod (leadscrew) and a multi-spoke handwheel assembly to complete the actuation mechanism.
